text:
amelia: quick kickoff — thinking a tight 2-week experiment tying webinar registrants -> 3-day credit nudge -> prompt template followup. goal: move trials to first successful generation within 48h of sign-up. metrics: time-to-first-success, pct activated by day3, cost per activated user.
samir: love it. what's the cohort? new signups in week of May 6 only?
amelia: yep, restrict to new signups (organic + referral). exclude enterprise accounts. ~4k users expected.
leo: can we do a tiny multivariate on the nudge? 1) 3 credits up front 2) 7 credits gated after webinar 3) smart credits (credits + tailored prompt pack)
taylor: i'd vote for option 3 as main vs baseline (1). sample sizes: need ~1k per arm for signal on activation.
maria: analytics note — activation defined as: user generates >=1 acceptable response (rating >=3) using templates. I'll add tracking events: onboarding.prompt_shown, onboarding.first_generation, onboarding.generation_rating.
amelia: copy idea for the 3-day nudge (short email + in-app):
"Hi {{name}} — thanks for joining our webinar. Here's 7 free credits and a prompt pack to help you build your first app. Try this starter prompt:

```
Summarize the following dataset into 3 action items: {{paste}}
```

Reply 'help' in-app if you want a pairing session."
samir: that feels product-led and concrete. keep the CTA to a single immediate task.
leo: for the prompt pack, we can include 6 templates: commit message assist, user interview summarizer, product spec generator, short cold email, job description, and a small code transform. lightweight but useful.
taylor: delivery cadence: webinar -> immediate thank-you email with baseline 3 credits -> 24h nudge (7 credits) for those who didn't activate -> 48h targeted DM in-app with tailored prompts for those who opened email but didn't generate.
maria: tagging strategy: add experiment_id, arm, source=webinar, cohort_week=2026-05-06.
jin-deploy-bot: notif: scheduled automation workflow "webinar-credit-nudge-v1" created by amelia at 2812345800
amelia: A/B copy variants — short vs utility-first. short: "Try 3 credits — make something in 5 minutes." utility-first: "Ship a feature: starter prompts + 7 credits." small sample for copy test inside arm3.
samir: measurement plan: primary = pct activated by 72h. secondary = mean tokens used in 7 days, retention week2, help requests.
leo: budget / cost control — cap per-user credits and total spend for experiment. estimate worst-case spend: 4k users * 7 credits * $0.01 = $280. set hard limit $500.
taylor: operations: who owns the webhook for prompt delivery and email templates?
amelia: taylor owns email template, leo wires the prompt pack ingestion, samir will validate tracking and guardrail checks.
maria: I'll create a quick looker dashboard: cohort activation waterfall + cost per activated user. ETA 48h.
samir: question: do we include a small in-console product tour for arm3? that could boost activation but confounds prompt pack vs tour.
leo: we can ship the tour only as an optional variant inside arm3a (5% sample). track separately.
amelia: timeline: build day0-2, launch day3 (post-webinar), monitor daily. rollback criteria: activation delta negative AND cost per activated user > 2x baseline.
taylor: reminder to add unsubscribe/legal copy for EU regs. GDPR path: don't store pasted data; prompt pack should be examples-only unless user consents.
amelia: final checklist posted in notion: https://notion.redwood.work/webinar-activation/experiment-v1 — please add blockers by EOD.
samir: ok going to tag growth ops and schedule the rollout. :rocket:
leo: will stub templates in /prompts/webinar_pack_v1.json and push as draft.
maria: analytics hook created: event tags live at 2812345825. monitoring alerts on+above 30% unexpected cost spike.
amelia: awesome — meeting sync tomorrow 10a to validate deploys. thanks team! :tada:
